title: eas framework
rule: EAS framework (named): Eliminate → Automate → Simplify (one row, not a re-dump of keep-short / device features).
pass_when: Form effort is attacked in that order: eliminate, then automate, then simplify what remains.
fail_when: The named order is inverted (simplify first while still asking for eliminable/automatable data).
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Re-listing `keep_short` / `use_device_features` / `compute_from_other_info` as this row. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.length.keep_short`, `compute_from_other_info`, `use_device_features`. One named EAS row only.
